recognize_zh: CD163 免疫染色下，組織內大片細胞呈強棕色膜及細胞質陽性，血管腔內還聚集體積明顯較大、有空泡或多核的異型陽性細胞，顯示這些異型細胞為組織球（巨噬細胞）來源。
features: Diffuse sheets of cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD163 positivity infiltrating the tissue
Clusters of large atypical CD163-positive cells within dilated vascular/sinusoidal spaces
Intravascular cells show abundant cytoplasm, some vacuolated, with occasional multinucleated or bizarre forms
Negative fibrous stroma and vessel walls at the top of the field
Hematoxylin counterstain; nuclear detail limited by strong chromogen
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD163 shows diffuse sheets of strongly positive cells infiltrating the tissue, together with clusters of large atypical, occasionally vacuolated or multinucleated CD163-positive cells lying within dilated vascular or sinusoidal spaces. The fibrous stroma is negative. Nuclear atypia is difficult to assess under the dense chromogen and should be evaluated on the H&E. Findings support histiocytic (macrophage) lineage of the atypical cells and, in a patient with a prior hematologic neoplasm, are consistent with secondary histiocytic sarcoma/malignant histiocytosis, although reactive histiocytes must be excluded by morphology and clonal studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are CD163 positive but cytologically bland, without marked nuclear atypia, mitoses or clonal genetic alterations shared with the prior neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other large cell lymphoma with intrasinusoidal spread
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD163 negative and express CD30, ALK or lymphoid lineage markers.
Langerhans cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a and langerin (CD207) positive, whereas CD163 is typically negative.
It can express CD163 but also shows CD34, CD117, MPO or lysozyme with blastic cytology and usually coexistent marrow AML.
